annotations.title: Update a sheet copied from a template

description: For a sheet copied from a shared template sheet (copiedFrom in list_tracks): which version of the template it's on, the newest, and what updating adds, tab by tab. change new: the newer version adds the tab. changed: its author changed the tab, so the new version is added beside the sheet's own as addAs ("Budget (version 3)") for the person to compare. removed_by_you: the person deleted the tab, so it isn't brought back. Updating never changes, overwrites or removes anything already in the sheet. Without apply it only looks. With apply true it updates: tell the person what it adds and apply only when they say so.

apply.description: true updates the sheet; leave out to only look.
